reviewMode: Current-source review, safe installed metadata comparison, existing evidence read, 6 frontend regression files; no new live Agent/account/model test.

findings.statement: Current common account response carries methods and canLogout only. Native current-account/status extensions are not normalized into the account UI. Existing-method/source labels do not establish current account identity or subscription/billing ownership.
findings.scope: OAuth/subscription account-management requirements; an API service label is not asserted to identify the API owner. Whether a particular Agent has an official status route remains per-Agent.

findings.statement: Logout/switch-account controls require standard auth.logout capability. Only 6 of the 33 current cached handshakes advertise it; 27 have no corresponding built-in exit/switch control. Native CLI/status/sign-out alternatives are not automatically represented by this gate.
findings.scope: Does not prove the Agent itself has no logout, and does not require forced login/logout for an API-only path. No real logout was run.

findings.statement: Production frontend consumes configOptions and a separate legacy modes path, but not models/current_model_update, and sends no session/set_model. Existing legacy-model Agents cannot have their model choice fully represented or changed through this path.

Connections are keyed by Agent/cwd/service rather than conversation. SetConfig busy/approval protection examines the target conversation. Agents with a single active conversation or process-wide model/cancel state need additional proven isolation.
findings.scope: Exact Agent-side behavior is in per-Agent evidence. Runtime cross-talk has not been newly reproduced.

findings.statement: Current history recovery rejects absent complete marker and unreadable/empty replay. Agent-side empty-success or post-response replay paths do not prove Farfold has accepted an empty history; they can prevent reliable import/restore and need bounded real verification.
findings.scope: Do not extrapolate a missing-session path to failure of every valid history.

findings.statement: A successful agent authenticate is marked operationConfirmed; the UI can describe login success. Goose/fast-agent installed-source authenticate paths perform no login and do not independently establish current account validity. Recheck restarts/initializes the connection, which is not an account-status query.
findings.scope: An empty authenticate response is standard success, not inherently invalid; this finding depends on those concrete no-op implementations. No account was changed.

primaryProtocolSources.note: logout must be advertised; {} is normal authenticate success; active-session effects after logout are not guaranteed
load must replay complete conversation before response; capability declaration itself is not successful restoration evidence
